metadata.title: Update Process Template
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Workflow for safely modifying existing process templates. Use when you need to update a template's steps, parameters, structure, or documentation while ensuring all references remain valid.

templateName.description: Name of the template to update

updateDescription.description: Description of what changes are needed
updateDescription.example: Add approval checkpoint after analysis step

changeScope.description: Scope of changes: minor (small fixes) or major (structural changes)

preserveActiveProcesses.description: Whether to warn if active processes use this template

steps.name: Analyze Current Artifact State
steps.output: Baseline analysis of artifact structure recorded to memory

steps.name: Plan Artifact Updates
steps.output: update-plan.md with proposed changes (including migration plan for active instances if applicable)
steps.guidance: When planning changes, check for active process instances using this template. If found, proactively include a migration plan (inserting new steps, renumbering, preserving existing IDs/statuses). Do not wait for the user to request migration.

steps.name: Apply Artifact Updates
steps.output: Modified artifact JSON and MD files with verified changes

steps.name: Review and Validate Artifact Updates
steps.output: review-report.md with plan compliance, quality assessment, and validation results
